ownerReview.review: KJV remaining New Testament complete-context review

evidence.label: Complete-verse KJV, NKJV, NIV, ESV and NRSVUE control

edits.expected: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as is fitting, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the love of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

edits.reason: Patience is perseverance amid actual persecutions, not passive tolerance of an opinion; faith remains distinct.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: as that the day of Christ is at hand
edits.replacement: as though the day of Christ had already come
edits.reason: Enesteken denotes a state already present, not merely imminent; preserves Christ in the KJV base rather than importing Lord from other controls. Verified TR and local references.
The apostasia is rebellion/defection, not a physical fall. Does not identify its historical agent or turn it into bodily departure; local controls.

Complete-verse KJV, NKJV, NIV, ESV and NRSVUE control

edits.expected: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God.

edits.reason: The restraining clause leads to the purpose of revelation in due time. Comma and so that keep the person revealed distinct from the thing restraining; no identity is supplied.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: he who now letteth will let
edits.replacement: he who now restrains will continue to restrain
edits.reason: Letteth has the old obstruct/restrain sense, the opposite of modern permit. Preserves the personal restrainer and until taken away; does not identify him. Local controls.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: The substantivized adjective designates the lawless person, not a proper name Wicked; leaves spirit of his mouth and coming intact.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: The noun concerns actual deception, not ability to be deceived; preserves those perishing and refusal of love of truth.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Damned here is a verdict of condemnation, not a swear word; the context remains judgment and is not softened to mere criticism.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Exact modern wording preserves the full verse meaning and grammar.
The word is to advance without hindrance, not an unpaid training course; preserves its being glorified.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Unreasonable is morally perverse in this context, not merely a disagreement about logic; local controls.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: for all men have not faith
edits.replacement: for not all men have faith
edits.reason: Moves the negation to preserve not everyone has faith, rather than suggesting nobody has faith; confirmed by the four local controls.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.expected: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
edits.replacement: Neither did we eat any man’s bread free of charge; but worked with labour and toil night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you:
edits.reason: Explains work/toil and financial burden; keeps the earlier free of charge repair and night/day labor. Travail is not childbirth here.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Power is the right to support, not physical incapacity; preserves the freely chosen example rather than abolishing that right.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: Ensample is the archaic form of example; Paul describes conduct the readers can follow.

edits.replacement: if anyone is unwilling to work
edits.reason: Would not marks refusal; explicitly not unable to work. The force of the old modal needs preservation to avoid applying the statement to incapacity. Local controls.

evidence.label: Versículo completo y contexto del texto base

edits.reason: By all means concerns every manner of peace, not authorization to use any means whatever; preserves always and the Lord as source.
